svg.title: The Caribbean and the Panama land bridge
svg.desc: Situation map covering 92.0°W to 58.0°W, 5.0°N to 27.5°N. A reference plate: two oceans, one isthmus, and the sea between them. Natural Earth physical geography; no thematic layer. Natural Earth 1:50m physical and cultural vectors; GMTED2010-derived texture-shaded relief.
